source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1017 replaces a mutable oneThread loop with isSingleThread = messages.every(...) after obtaining the first root header message key. The accepted pane keeps the same positive predicate and chooses thread versus multipleselection from it. Use a named boolean that states what the collection satisfies for this grouping decision. This is a local clarity proposal, not a performance rule or a ban on loops.
title: Keep thread grouping decisions declarative and name the predicate result
